orders.title: Rekindle the Brazier
orders.blurb: Two Flame Gems, Keeper. The old brazier will not light itself, and I am far too dignified to dig.

orders.title: Warm the Long Hearth
orders.blurb: Your little dragon keeps coughing up shards — splendid. Forge me FOUR Flame Gems and the hall will be warm by supper.

orders.title: A Centerpiece Worth the Name
orders.blurb: One Radiant Gem. ONE. Merge three Flame Gems into something that would make the old court gasp.

orders.title: The Keeper's Hoard
orders.blurb: Three Radiant Gems, Keeper. A proper hoard for a proper Keep — and proof the Flame is truly back.
